body.query: query Catalogue { topProducts(first: 100) { upc name price weight notes } }

expectation.description: Read every product available from the original fixture with its original scalar values.

operations.name: Complete product inventory and shipping inputs

body.query: query Inventory { topProducts(first: 100) { upc name price weight inStock shippingEstimate } }

expectation.description: Resolve product entities through products and inventory, including native price/weight requirements.

body.query: query DefaultProducts { topProducts { upc name } }

expectation.description: Retain the original upstream default argument behavior.

body.query: query LimitedProducts($first: Int!) { topProducts(first: $first) { upc name price } }

expectation.description: Apply the exact supplied integer variable through the native router.

body.query: query CurrentAccount { me { id name username birthday } }

expectation.description: Read the original fixture's current account and its full selected fields.

body.query: query Accounts { users { id name username birthday } }

expectation.description: Read all original account rows exposed by the fixture.

body.query: query Account($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { id name username birthday } }

expectation.description: Resolve the retained original account identifier without rewriting it.

body.query: query MissingAccount($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { id name username } }

expectation.description: Preserve the original native null or error result for an absent account.

operations.name: Account to review, product and inventory

body.query: query AccountReviews { me { id name reviews { id body product { upc name price weight inStock shippingEstimate } } } }

expectation.description: Resolve the original account's complete review/product/inventory traversal.

operations.name: Product to review and complete author

body.query: query ProductReviews { topProducts(first: 100) { upc name reviews { id body author { id name username birthday } } } }

expectation.description: Retain the original reviews/author provides and account lookup behavior.

body.query: query AliasedProducts { first: topProducts(first: 1) { upc name } all: topProducts(first: 100) { upc name } }

expectation.description: Preserve both alias result positions in the original response.

body.query: query FragmentProducts { topProducts(first: 100) { ...ProductFields reviews { id body author { ...AccountFields } } } } fragment ProductFields on Product { upc name price weight inStock shippingEstimate } fragment AccountFields on User { id name username }

expectation.description: Use the original GraphQL fragment planner across products, inventory, reviews and accounts.

body.query: query ConditionalProducts($includeReviews: Boolean!) { topProducts(first: 100) { upc name reviews @include(if: $includeReviews) { id body author { id username } } } }

expectation.description: Keep the native omitted branch when the exact Boolean variable is false.

body.query: query ConditionalProducts($includeReviews: Boolean!) { topProducts(first: 100) { upc name reviews @include(if: $includeReviews) { id body author { id username } } } }

expectation.description: Resolve the complete review branch when the exact Boolean variable is true.

operations.name: Select the named operation from a document

body.query: query FirstSelection { me { id name } } query SecondSelection { topProducts(first: 100) { upc name } }

expectation.description: Retain the original operationName choice; do not execute the other operation.

body.query: query ProductsGet($first: Int!) { topProducts(first: $first) { upc name inStock shippingEstimate } }

expectation.description: Send the full query/variables/operationName via the original GET encoding.

body.query: query UnknownField { topProducts { upc missingReferenceField } }

expectation.description: Preserve the complete original validation errors, locations, extensions and HTTP status.

body.query: query RequiredAccount($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { id name } }

expectation.description: Preserve the native error for the omitted required variable.

body.query: query WrongProductLimit($first: Int!) { topProducts(first: $first) { upc name } }

expectation.description: Preserve the native error for the exact invalid variable value.

body.query: query SelectedSchema { topProducts(first: 100) { upc name internal } }

expectation.description: Initial and rollback use the original field. The explicitly reviewed changed supergraph removes this field and retains its native validation outcome.
